item.title: Oil tanker has exploded in Strait of Hormuz, says Iran’s IRGC
item.description: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said late on Monday that an oil tanker had struck a sea mine and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz. The tanker El Gaia was travelling along the southern route through the strait, which was mined by Iran, state broadcaster IRIB reported, citing the IRGC. The entire vessel went up in flames following the detonation of the mine, it said. item.title: Hutíes de Yemen: ¿quiénes son y qué representan?
item.description: El grupo armado hutí de Yemen, respaldado por Irán, pertenece a la rama zaidí del chiismo y surgió en la década de 1990 en el noroeste del país, en los alrededores de la ciudad de Saada.El movimiento, conocido como "Partidarios de Dios", nació para denunciar la discriminación contra su comunidad y, una década más tarde, se transformó en una poderosa fuerza política y militar. En France 24 hacemos un repaso por la historia de los hutíes. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Rights group accuses Israel of dismantling 'Palestinian existence' in West Bank
item.description: Israeli rights group B'Tselem said Monday that Israeli actions in the occupied West Bank form part of a greater project designed to make it impossible for Palestinians to exist together as a people. In a report titled "The Elimination Project", the group alleged five connected Israeli tactics and policies in the West Bank: "violence, ethnic cleansing, movement restrictions, economic strangulation, social and political destruction". item.title: Yemen: Fact-checking videos claiming to show Houthi rebel attacks
item.description: A video claiming to show Houthi rebels ambushing Saudi-backed mercenaries has racked up major views on X. But the FRANCE 24 Observers found it is actually footage of 2024 Houthi military drills. The clip was edited with football commentary and blurred flags, which originally show Israel, the UK and US, not Saudi Arabia. Other viral videos falsely linked to Houthi attacks on a Saudi Aramco refinery were also traced to unrelated fires in Texas and Russia. Vedika Bahl fact-checks in Truth or Fake. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Vedika BAHL
